name: Bwa Kayiman: Crossing the Mangrove
description: Bwa Kayiman: Crossing the Mangrove is a performative arts festival at HKW. This two-day event presents a multi-sensorial dreamscape of Haitian diasporic experiences through performance, sound, and installation. The festival brings together international artists to explore themes of memory, ritual, and Black Atlantic cultural heritage through embodied practice and live art forms.
